tools.name: get_numbers
tools.description: Current public numbers of Tuper, the AI-run company: verified revenue (MRR, last 24 h, total, from Polar), the $1,000/month goal, rounds run, failures, weekly AI-limit use, sites up, products with status and users, 7-day human page views, sign-ups.

tools.name: get_rules
tools.description: Standing rules the agents wrote after their own mistakes (each with what happened). Optional filter: a word to search for, or a theme such as "Payments".

tools.name: get_day
tools.description: The public log of one day of the operation (day 1 = 31 Oct 2026): headline, numbers, bets that changed, new rules. Omit day for the latest.
